notes: ON arms: a collection with no ranked topic (no taxonomy at its dimension) is searched unscoped, as the engine's no_topics does. The ungated ON arms of this run therefore differ from the saved leg-1 run, which skipped such a collection.
A collection that has ranked topics but none inside a band arm's band is still skipped (the 'skipped' list per arm). The band arms are the spike's global-band proxy; the engine has no band mode.
No zero-row fallback in any ON arm (it predates this run; taxonomy_ab2 measures F0/Fk), so the band arms understate what the engine returns when a routed topic comes back empty.

Gated arms leave a gated collection out of the topic ranking (it sets no band) and search it unscoped from the OFF rows; ungated and gated arms share one OFF search, one ranking and one topic-read cache.
